newsitem.title: USA: Assets of U.S. money market funds rose in week.
newsitem.headline: Assets of U.S. money market funds rose in week.

text.p: Total money market mutual fund assets in the week ended January 22 rose to $940.14 billion from a revised $931.74 billion the prior week, an industry trade group said Thursday.
The Investment Company Institute said assets of the nation's 652 retail money market mutual funds fell $398.4 million to $623.47 billion in the week.

Of the retail funds, assets of the 395 taxable money market funds rose $95.8 million to $507.58 billion, while assets of the 257 tax-exempt funds fell $494.2 million to $115.89 billion, the group said.

ICI said assets of the 320 institutional money market funds rose $8.80 billion to $316.67 billion. Of these, assets of the 257 taxable money market funds increased $8.69 billion to $285.05 billion, while assets of the 63 tax-exempt funds rose $101 million to $31.62 billion, it said.
